notes.themes.colorScheme: This app stores nothing in the browser, so its theme cannot be set through localStorage or a query parameter. The copied browser-check.mjs has one added line that passes themes.<name>.colorScheme to the browser context, and the app follows prefers-color-scheme.
notes.complete route: /complete/:documentId redirects to /documents unless a document was signed in this session, so it is covered by journey-check.mjs, not here.
notes.colourRules: None: the app has no chart or banded value (app-plan.md, Colour semantics).
